data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek 'Christos' meaning 'anointed one'. The name Kristyn signifies 'beloved of Christ' in the Christian faith. The name Kristyn carries the meaning “Beloved of Christ” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kristyn usually hope their child will grow to embody beloved of christ and live with faith, good character and purpose.
